/**
 * POISON PILL for tests/arch-snapshot-repo-binding.test.mjs.
 *
 * Not loaded as a module — read as TEXT and fed to the analyser, so it can
 * assert the guard goes RED on the shape it exists to catch. `.txt` so no
 * test runner, linter or the relocation guard picks it up as real source.
 *
 * Three functions, deliberately:
 *   - `readsUnboundSnapshot`     the plain unbound read (must FLAG)
 *   - `readsUnboundViaProjection` selects `repo_id` but never filters on it —
 *                                the false-pass a naive "does the body mention
 *                                repo_id?" check would wave through, and the
 *                                exact shape `listSymbolsForSnapshot` had
 *                                before 2026-09-04 (must FLAG)
 *   - `readsBound`               correctly bound (must NOT flag — a guard that
 *                                fires on everything is not a guard)
 */
import { one, many } from '../../db/query.mjs';

export async function readsUnboundSnapshot(refreshId) {
  return many(
    `SELECT rule_name FROM symbol_layering_violations
      WHERE refresh_id = $1`,
    [refreshId],
  );
}

export async function readsUnboundViaProjection(refreshId) {
  return many(
    `SELECT si.id, si.repo_id, si.file_path
       FROM symbol_index si
      WHERE si.refresh_id = $1`,
    [refreshId],
  );
}

export async function readsBound(refreshId, repoId) {
  return one(
    `SELECT payload FROM symbol_refresh_coverage c
       JOIN refresh_runs rr ON rr.id = c.refresh_id AND rr.repo_id = $2
      WHERE c.refresh_id = $1`,
    [refreshId, repoId],
  );
}
